title: 🌟 Interactive Particle Dance with JavaScript Canvas 🖱️
description:
I’ve created an Interactive Particle Dance using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript! This project features a swarm of light blue particles drifting across a black canvas, reacting to your mouse movements by scattering away and then gently returning to their natural flow. It’s a simple yet engaging effect! 🎉

  • What’s it about? Particles move randomly across the screen and flee from the mouse cursor within a set radius, creating an interactive visual experience.

  • The result? A hypnotic swarm that feels alive and responds to your touch.

  • Main key of the code: The updateParticle function calculates mouse distance and adjusts particle velocity, while requestAnimationFrame keeps the animation smooth.

  • How can users benefit? Add it as an interactive background, tweak particle count, radius, or colors for your needs, or explore mouse-driven animations!
shortDescription: ✨ Particles scatter from your mouse in a cosmic dance, built with JS Canvas. Great for interactive fun!
